updates.text: Implemented an operator dashboard with weather panels, storm detour logic, manual stick control, and a live telemetry sheet for Ark‑1.
Tick the market every 10 minutes from GitHub Actions.
Started tiny-gpu: a Verilog GPU for an iCE40UP5K FPGA that rasterises triangles into a 64×64 framebuffer and drives a 640×480 VGA display via USB.
Implemented a GPU core with clear, triangle, and present functions, added a triangle rasteriser with a 64×64 framebuffer, and enabled 640×480 VGA output scaled 7×.
A live compute price index with hourly futures on NEAR, publishing a matched‑quote index and auto‑settling contracts, now includes a news feed and dark theme.
Started Noah-Ark: an autonomous amphibious delivery drone with edge perception and AWS Bedrock AI for triage, planning, and dispatch.
Started near-hackathon-2026: a live compute price index with hourly futures on NEAR, publishing a matched‑quote index and auto‑settling contracts.
Implemented a PowerShell orchestrator that decomposes tasks, launches detached Claude or OpenCode agents to write files, then reviews diffs and commits.
